notes: myCFNA Rewards is tiered on calendar-year net spend: Passenger and Driver (under $2,500) earn 3% at Firestone Complete Auto Care, Adventurer ($2,500 and up) earns 4%. The program is operated and funded by the credit division of Bridgestone Retail Operations, LLC. No Mastercard network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
